programme.title: Big City Greens - Breaking News; Cyberbullies

programme.title: Big City Greens - Tilly Tour; Dinner Party
programme.desc: Tilly takes Gramma out to be a tourist for a day; Cricket and Remy arrange a dinner party for everyone to get to know each other. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2018-08-06

programme.title: Big City Greens - Big Deal; Forbidden Feline
programme.desc: Cricket persuades the family to go to a Thanksgiving sale at a big-box store for a deal on a new television; Tilly becomes friends with Anoosh, the neighborhood cat. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2018-11-03

programme.title: Big City Greens - Coffee Quest; Phoenix Rises
programme.desc: When Big City faces a coffee bean shortage, Cricket and Gloria's boss, Ms. Cho, challenges them to retrieve one of the few remaining sacks of coffee; when the Greens' dog, Phoenix, runs away from home, the family sets out to find her. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2018-08-08

programme.title: Big City Greens - Uncaged
programme.desc: Cricket and Tilly's mother, Nancy Green, returns to the city. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2019-01-11

programme.title: Big City Greens - Night Bill; Cheap Snake
programme.desc: When Bill sneaks out at night with a mysterious duffel bag, the kids hide in his truck to see where he goes; Cricket impulsively buys a giant pet snake. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2019-01-19

programme.title: Big City Greens - Harvest Dinner; Winner Winner
programme.desc: Bill and Nancy prep a special harvest dinner; Cricket and Gramma race Tilly to get a missing ingredient; at the local community center, Tilly wants to win a trophy and begins training with the center's director. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2019-01-12

programme.title: Big City Greens - Hiya Henry; People Watching
programme.desc: Tilly tries ventriloquism for the Big Coffee open mic night; the family plays the people-watching game, making up stories about city folk passing by. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2019-01-26

programme.title: Big City Greens - Hurty Tooth; Sleepover Sisters
programme.desc: The Greens go on a family visit to the dentist's office, where Cricket is determined to avoid Dr. Enamel and power through his toothache. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2019-02-09

programme.title: Big City Greens - TRAILER TROUBLE/ MANSION MADNESS
programme.desc: When Nancy's trailer is stolen by her old biker gang, the kids resolve to get it back; Cricket house-sits for Remy, but things go awry when the rest of the Greens visit. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2019-02-16

programme.title: Big City Greens - Valentine's Dance; Green Streets
programme.desc: At the Valentine's Dance, Cricket develops an unwanted crush on Gabriella; Cricket joins forces with Officer Keys to hunt down a neighborhood litterbug. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2019-02-02

programme.title: Big City Greens - Park Pandemonium; Cricket's Biscuits
programme.desc: Gramma spurns Tilly at the city park, so Tilly tries making her jealous; Gramma makes special biscuits for the kids when they're hurt, but won't make more when they're better. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2019-02-23

programme.title: Big City Greens - Skunked; Axin' Saxon

programme.title: Big City Greens - Cricket's Place; Volunteer Tilly
programme.desc: When Remy and Cricket get their own apartment, they discover that nonstop fun leads to chaos; Tilly volunteers at the animal shelter but doesn't want to part with any of the animals. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2019-03-09

programme.title: Big City Greens - Times Circle; Super Gramma
programme.desc: Tilly and Remy put on a play; Cricket meets his favorite heroes; when Gramma temporarily loses her eyesight, Cricket and Tilly try to help her. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2020-08-29

programme.title: Big City Greens - Present Tense; Hurt Bike

programme.title: Big City Greens - Quiet Please; Chipwrecked
programme.desc: At the library, the Greens try to find a book, but a scary librarian threatens them into being quiet; Chip decides if he is really the failure Cricket says he is. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2020-09-19

programme.title: Big City Greens - Chipocalypse Now Part 1; Chipocalypse Now Part 2

programme.title: Big City Greens - 'Rent Control; Pool's Gold

programme.title: Big City Greens - Mages and Mazes; Okay Karaoke
programme.desc: When the kids play a role-playing game at Remy's, his rules lead to conflict; when the Greens go out for karaoke, Tilly struggles to decide what genre of music will best express her true self. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2021-02-06

programme.title: Big City Greens - Date Night; The Room
programme.desc: Bill chaperones Cricket and Gabriella's first date; a disagreement between Cricket and Tilly turns into reality-TV-like entertainment for Gloria and Gramma. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2021-02-13

programme.title: Big City Greens - Bleeped; Sellouts

programme.title: Big City Greens - Fast Foodie; Spaghetti Theory
programme.desc: Cricket tries to prove to Bill he can eat fast food for every meal; Tilly and Cricket debate whether the lives of people in Big City are connected. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2021-03-13

programme.title: Big City Greens - Ding Dongers; Animation Abomination

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013-04-23

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2011-05-03

programme.title: We Bare Bears
programme.desc: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2015-07-27
